headline: Illinois Tool Works (ITW) Is Up 8.5% After Raising 2026 Guidance And Boosting Share Buybacks
summary: In the past week, Illinois Tool Works Inc. reported Q2 2026 results showing sales rising to US$4,301 million and net income to US$815 million, with diluted EPS from continuing operations increasing to US$2.84 compared with a year earlier. The company also raised its full-year 2026 GAAP EPS and revenue growth guidance while continuing sizeable share repurchases, highlighting management’s confidence in operations and capital-allocation discipline. headline: Illinois Tool Works (ITW) Stock Trades Up, Here Is Why
summary: Shares of manufacturing company Illinois Tool Works (NYSE:ITW) jumped 4.7% in the morning session after the company reported second-quarter 2026 earnings that beat Wall Street estimates on both the top and bottom lines. The industrial products maker posted revenue of $4.3 billion, a 6.1% increase year on year, surpassing consensus estimates. Earnings came in at $2.84 per share, which was also ahead of expectations.
